recommendation: Keep the commit as-is for the R5 clarification. If FHIR-48997 or a future work-group decision approves a statusReason extension or core element for Consent, handle that separately in the Extension Pack or future core source.
issue_request: FHIR-31377 asked to add a reason associated with Consent status. The Published Not Persuasive with Modification resolution chose not to add Consent.statusReason; it required status code descriptions to clarify that status is the resource status, not the patient's consent status, and requested Scope guidance for using Provenance, DocumentReference, and Contract to track ceremony/status-change context.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged source commit ec8ea03fab4 added the requested Scope paragraph to source/consent/consent-introduction.xml. Later cleanup made Consent.status itself say it indicates the current state of this Consent resource, but the active ConsentState CodeSystem, ValueSet, binding description, and individual code definitions still used 'state of the consent' wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes consent=Consent and codesystem=CodeSystem, so the edited Consent terminology and StructureDefinition sources are in build scope. FHIR-31769 is a same-family no-change decision stating that ConsentState is the state of the Consent resource, while the state of the consent itself belongs in the source document. A later FHIR-extensions request, FHIR-48997, asks to allow event-statusReason on Consent but remains Triaged/unresolved and does not supersede the core decision.
reconciliation: Updated source/consent/codesystem-consent-state-codes.xml, source/consent/valueset-consent-state-codes.xml, and source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml to consistently refer to the Consent resource state. No Consent.statusReason element was added, and the already-applied Scope paragraph was left intact.
source_changes: source/consent/codesystem-consent-state-codes.xml: changed the CodeSystem description and all ConsentState concept definitions to refer to the Consent resource.
source/consent/valueset-consent-state-codes.xml: changed the ValueSet description to refer to the Consent resource state.
source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml: changed the Consent.status required binding description to refer to the Consent resource state.

related_jiras.note: Same ConsentState family; a no-change comment explicitly says Consent state is the state of the Consent resource, not the state of the consent itself.
Later Published change added the abandoned Consent.status code; this reconciliation preserves that code and clarifies its definition scope.
Later FHIR-extensions request to allow event-statusReason on Consent remains Triaged and unresolved, so it is not a final core-source decision.
